buildCommand: npm install --prefix glowup-app && npm run build --prefix glowup-app

headers.comment: The app shell must never be served stale — a cached index.html can point at hashed bundles a later deploy has already rotated away.
The service worker itself must not be cached, or a broken one can never be replaced.
Vite hashes these filenames, so they are safe to cache hard and forever.
